body:
lina (eng-platform): Heads up — saw a cluster of websocket streams go into a silent pause after quota throttles in canary. Connection stays ESTABLISHED but no frames are delivered.

sam (eng-runtime): Yep saw that too. client keeps TCP open, no ECONNRESET, so reconnect logic never triggers.

jamal (oncall): Hit this at 2026-03-19T13:02 UTC — conn id=abc123. Logs show 429 from quota-proxy then nothing.

lina (eng-platform): Logs:
```
2026-03-19T13:02:12Z quota-proxy[proxy-2] WARN tenant=acme action=throttle code=429 conn=abc123
2026-03-19T13:02:12Z ws-proxy[edge-5] INFO conn=abc123 state=ESTABLISHED last_sent=2026-03-19T13:01:59Z last_recv=2026-03-19T13:02:05Z
```

sam (eng-runtime): Root cause looks like sticky-routing + opaque session tokens: quota-proxy rejects new requests but doesn't push a control event on existing streams, so edge keeps stream open but silent.

maria (product): From UX side console shows "connected" which is misleading. Customers see no updates but no error. Can we surface "paused" state? :eyes: 

lina (eng-platform): Proposal: 1) quota-proxy emits a control frame on affected streams describing throttle. 2) edge marks stream_state=paused in telemetry and optionally closes with a server-recommended retry code. 3) console shows a "paused due to quota" badge and tenant-level aggregate.

sam (eng-runtime): For WebSocket we can send a JSON control message: `{"type":"control","reason":"quota","code":429,"suggested_retry_ms":60000}`. For SSE we can use a comment/control line e.g. `:quota:429 retry=60000`. But some clients ignore control frames/comments.

jamal (oncall): If we start closing streams aggressively we risk reconnection storms. Need server-suggested retry + jitter/backoff baked into runtime. Also coordinate rate-limiter windows so reconnections are sequenced.

lina (eng-platform): Agreed. Plan: emit control frame + suggested_retry_ms + do not immediate-close. Edge will set stream_state=paused and surface telemetry; only close if pause exceeds X and we want to free resources. Add exponential backoff for reconnect windows.

maria (product): Dashboard asks what telemetry fields we need.

lina (eng-platform): Minimal set: `stream_state` (active/paused/closing), `last_quota_code`, `suggested_retry_ms`, `throttle_window_id`, `pause_start_ts`. Expose per-tenant counts and sample connections.

sam (eng-runtime): Cardinality risk noted. We'll sample 1% of active streams for full dimensions + emit full telemetry for any stream that sees a throttle/error.

jamal (oncall): Add alert: `if >5% active streams paused for >30s in region => pager` and `if single tenant >2% paused => paging on owner`.

lina (eng-platform): I'll draft the PR: wire control messages in quota-proxy + edge telemetry hook + console indicator + docs.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to canary at 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z.

maria (product): Also add a small customer-facing banner in console when tenant has any paused streams. Notifying is important so they know it's quota-related, not a bug.

sam (eng-runtime): I'll prototype the control frame payload and add a short playbook for clients: sample pseudocode and reconnection strategy. Link will be in PR.

lina (eng-platform): TL;DR: emit control frames on throttles, mark stream_state, conservative close policy + backoff, console visibility + alerts. Opening PR now. :writing_hand:
